abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Houtbeheer integration can be set up.

data_description.ready_threshold: A shed is ready to burn when its saved moisture is below this limit. Default 20%.
data_description.wood_types: Wood types you can choose per shed. Type to add a new one; remove one with the cross. The order here is the order on the card. A type that is still in a shed cannot be removed.

wood_types.name: Wood types
